cases.prompt: A porous scaffold meets a yield-strength target but collapses under cyclic perfusion. Identify two failure mechanisms missed by a one-time compression test and propose an accelerated but interpretable test plan.

rubric.criterion: Identifies fatigue, creep, degradation, buckling, or strut damage
Includes relevant wet/37°C or degradation environment
Specifies cyclic loading, controls, measured stiffness/porosity/flow, and stopping criteria

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.
